tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250dam can zhing skyong gnyis kyi sgrub pa'i sgab 'dre mnan pa'i man ngag bzhugs so// 1$0000300na maḥshrī pra bha ma hā kā la ya/ 'dir ni yang dag bshad bya ba// slob dpon nus pa ldan pa yis// sgab 'dre legs par mnan pa na// slob brgyud mi rabs bcu gsum mam// bdun nam tha ma'ang gsum gyi bar// ma mnan na yang skyon med zer/ kho bos lan gsum mnan na yang*// mnan pa grub na bkra shis dge/ mnan tshul rgyas bsdus mang na yang*// sgrub pa rtags thon dgos phyir dka'// sgrub mi dgos par mnan chog pa// ma hā ba la 'di nyid zab// de las gsar rnying rigs mang yang*// gnam chos 'di nyid zab cing rno// zhing skyong dam can gnyis ka yi// sgrub pa'i bar chad sgab 'dre ni// shog bur snag tsha gtsang ma yis// liṅga gcig la mgo gsum pa// dbus mi g.yas bya g.yon spre'u// lag pa mi la rkang pa bya// spre'u'i mjug ma yod pa bri// snying ga dzaḥganyis kha sprod bar// tri yig gsum ni brtsegs mar bri// de mthar yig mgo phyir bstan la// sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa sgab 'dre lag ring*/ btsan yam shud dmar po/ 'byung po the'u rang stong 'khrug gsum khug cig /mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥrbad nan/ ces bri/ spyi bor nan dang rkang zhabs yaṃ// yan lag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbri// tha mar dzaḥdang khram gyis bskor// de la 'gugs gzhug brgya rtsa bya// ma hā ba la'i sku gzugs ni// gnam chos bzhin du bris pa la// bskyed bstim rang sngags brgya rtsa bzla// ro g.yam rdo rje rgya gram dang*// ri rab gling bzhi bcas pa bri// mchod rten 'og gam lam rgya gram// lha khang ngam ni sgrub khang gi /them 'og gru gsum dong brus la// dam sri liṅga mgo phyir bstan// gan rkyal mnan nas 'gugs gzhug bya// de steng ma hā ba la bzhag /sa khod re la rgya gram re// dgu bri ro g.yam rgya gram mnan// de steng me khrol chu thigs blug

/legs par bcags la mi mngon bya// de steng rta bro gang rung brdung*// rkang pa g.yon pas rgya gram mnan// de ltar bya ba gal che zhing*// lo 'ga' song nas bskyar yang legs// de skad rā ga a syas smras/// /
